text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday, Miracle-chan! ...Huh? Are 
you zoning out?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I was just lost in thought. Thinking 
about how this day has come around once 
again.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah—, I get it, you know? Feeling like 
you've grown a year older. Though I'll 
probably be saying the exact same thing 
next year.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Next year too, huh... Yeah, you're right.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(—Next year, and the year after that... 
...I've gotta use these legs to pay them 
back.)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Did I say something similar last year 
too? Ahaha, you ask what's changed since 
then~? Nooothing at all!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
So what if nothin' changes?! The fact that 
you're workin' your butt off ain't changed 
neither, has it?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I'm doing things my own way here! 
It's my birthday, so at least give me a 
reward for the year!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Just kidding! Come on, let's go eat cake! 
...Hm, huh? Miracle-chan, what's wrong?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...*giggle*, ahaha! No, it's fine. Thank 
you, Hishi Miracle."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh? Heheh, you're welcome, I guess?
